reel.caption:
Can your bank fine you until your balance goes below ₹0?

RBI guidelines on minimum-balance charges (in force since April 2015) say the fine can't turn a savings account balance negative.
Before any fine, the bank must tell you about the shortfall by SMS, email or letter and give you at least a month to top up. The fine must be in proportion to the shortfall.
Seeing a minus balance? Complain to the bank in writing first, then to the RBI ombudsman.

Has a bank ever shown you a minus balance?

Sources: the RBI circular on penal charges for non-maintenance of minimum balance (Dec 2014) and a fact-check explainer on the same rules.

For education only. Not investment advice.
